Independent exact matrix multiplication yields trace/determinant signs and the DR threshold factorization; for strict s>s*, DR<0 implies LRR unstable positive >1 with stable (0,1); LL R characteristic value at -1 negative implies multiplier below -1 and stable (0,1). No derivative at switching line asserted. All inequalities in proof use strict stated determinant/slope restrictions; finite rational checker not elevated to universal proof.
